actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Outreach action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Outreach connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_template_to_sequence_step
actions.title: Add a template to sequence step
actions.description: Add a template to a sequence step in Outreach
actions.help: Provide the sequence step ID and a template ID to associate with the sequence.

actions.name: search_object
actions.title: Search records
actions.help: Fetches multiple records. The records can be filtered and sorted according to the specified attributes. By default, this action returns a maximum of 1000 rows. Note that not all attributes permit filter and sort criteria. Please check Outreach API reference for more details.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object to search for
